utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m glad we’re talking book club. What are you thinking for the next read?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, sorry I’m a little late — I’m happy to join. I’d be up for something lively and discussion-friendly; what are the options?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries at all — I’ve got a few lively picks in mind, and I can send them over so we can choose one that’ll spark a good discussion.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Hana — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say for certain.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — just let me know when you check, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring snacks and extra pens for book club—just tell me how many people are coming.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still checking who’s coming, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have a count.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Noah—I’ll keep the snacks and pens ready. Just ping me when you know the headcount.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious what the book club is reading next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think they’re choosing between a couple of titles, but I’d want to confirm the date and whether everyone can get a copy first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — do you know when they’ll decide? I can try to get a copy in time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still meeting at your place for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina — I think so, but I’m waiting on the final time from the others. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — can you text me the time once it’s set?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club’s been lively lately — everyone’s got strong opinions, which makes it pretty fun. I’ll tell you, the snacks are almost as talked about as the books!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ha, sounds like my kind of book club — good debate and good snacks. If you need any folding tables or extra chairs, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s mighty kind of you, Gus — we might take you up on that when the next meeting gets crowded. I’ll keep you posted; the group’s already arguing over the next pick!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, definitely—we’re meeting Wednesday evening at my place, and you should come! I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll watch for the details and put Wednesday evening on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll text you the address and time tonight, and if you want, bring your favorite snack. It should be a cozy little gathering!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great — what book is the club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, we’re definitely reading the same book this time, right? Which one is it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we are — but I don’t know the title yet. Want to check the group chat together?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m excited to help get the book club rolling. What kind of books do you think folks on the block would enjoy most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’d say something easy to get into—good mysteries, funny fiction, and maybe one short nonfiction pick now and then. Folks are busy, so anything lively and not too long would probably work best.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a great mix, Bo — lively and manageable is exactly right. I’ll start with a mystery, a funny novel, and a short nonfiction option so everyone has something inviting to choose from.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring that up at book club and repeat the plan to everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. That sounds like a good plan—just keep it simple and clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and make sure everyone hears the plan clearly at book club.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club! I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’d love to hear what book you picked this time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I picked a short novel this time—thought we could keep it gentle. I’ll bring the copy to book club.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds lovely—thank you, Uli! I’ll try to remember to bring my glasses this time so I can keep up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bring folks together for book club—what’s the latest on the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’ve heard folks are leaning toward next Thursday evening at the community room, and I’m checking on a couple more chairs and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great — I can help round up a few extra chairs and I’ll bring some snacks too. Just let me know what else you need for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll spread the word about the book club right away. Want me to invite anyone in particular?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, could you invite Mira and Ben if they’re free? I’ll probably swing by a bit late, as usual.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll invite Mira and Ben and let them know you may be a little late. See you there when you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet—what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading *The Midnight Library* this month. I can bring the meeting time and the discussion questions if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. I’d like the meeting time and questions if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work, but I’ll need to plan around the school pickup first. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works — how about 7 pm? If school pickup runs late, we can be flexible and shift a little.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7 pm should work for me. I’ll confirm once I know how pickup goes, and if I’m running late I’ll message you right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh nice — the book club’s been a good way to get everyone talking. What are you thinking for the next read?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we keep it light next time—maybe a fun mystery or something easy to chat about, and I can float a couple options to the group.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect — a light mystery would keep the discussion fun without feeling like homework. If you want, I can help you narrow down a few options for the group.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia — happy to help out with the book club however I can. Need a hand with setup, books, or snacks?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — could you help with setup and maybe bring a few extra chairs? I’m a little worried we’ll be short on space.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can handle setup and bring a few extra chairs. I’ll swing by a bit early so we’ve got everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any book club details yet, Rosa, but I can help keep track of where and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an eye out for the date and place, and let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—just send me the date, time, and location when you get them, and I’ll keep it all straight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we settle on the next book club pick yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t think we’ve settled it yet—didn’t we narrow it down to a couple of options?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right, I think we had a couple options. Which one are we leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Sam — could you help keep track of the snacks and extra chairs for book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of the snacks and extra chairs for book club.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the book club—what’s it like so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: It’s been pretty nice so far—mostly just a small group chatting about the book, though I keep forgetting which one we’re on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds cozy enough for me—I’m still catching up on which book we’re even reading, so you’re ahead of me there!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we actually meeting about the book club tonight, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m pretty sure it’s still up in the air, but I can check around and let you know if anyone has made it official.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—could you confirm it before I head over? I’d rather not show up if it’s still undecided.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting got moved to Thursday evening—did you want me to check what they’re reading next?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be kind, thank you. I can make Thursday if it’s not too late.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll ask and let you know what they picked. If Thursday runs late, I can also see whether they’ve set a start time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m glad you mentioned it. I might be a bit scattered, but I’d love to join and hear what everyone’s reading.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — we meet Thursday at 7 in my garage. I’ll save you a spot and send the book title.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — Thursday at 7 in your garage, got it. I’ll do my best to remember the book title, but I’m grateful you’re saving me a spot!
